Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely treated “Las Palmas de Gran Canaria” as the tentative birthplace based on user-contributed/less authoritative sources (IMDb, Find a Grave) without resolving conflicts or consulting a more authoritative source (e.g., Wikidata P19 or national archives). This mis-prioritization could have led to an incorrect final answer before later correction to Madrid.
